summary: Granddaughter of Richard Heffernan and Anastasia Boney and wife of the Leadville mine owner Richard Dillon; John's 2nd cousin 4 times removed.
bio: Anna S. Heffernan was born in 1859, a granddaughter of Richard Heffernan and Anastasia Boney. She married Richard Dillon (1850–1927), a former owner of the Little Chief mine at Leadville, Colorado. In July 1880 Dillon was shot by a faro dealer at Leadville. He survived, and the news went out in Annie's own brief words: "Dick is shot; getting along well. Annie Dillon." She died in 1914; her husband outlived her and died at Globe, Arizona, in 1927. She is John's 2nd cousin 4 times removed.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh (quoting The Sun (NY) 29 Jul 1880 and the Wilkes-Barre Record of the Times 30 Jul 1880)
